Its captured FinOps case studies describe resource ownership mapping, pricing recommendations, cloud budgets and forecasts, and coordinated optimization. FinOps means cloud financial management connecting financial and technical decisions. Seacliff Technology Advisors is a fictional analogue modeling a bounded US advisory unit. Its three-person pod serves two continuing US enterprise technology clients whose finance and engineering organizations consume its recommendations. Synthetic scale: 16 cloud accounts, approximately 45 application services and $800,000 combined monthly cloud expenditure. Ordinary work includes weekly consumption reviews, investigation of six to ten new cost findings per week, two monthly client reporting packages, allocation maintenance, quarterly commitment assessments and follow-up on previously implemented optimizations. Eighteen months of billing and decision history establish continuing relationships beyond individual episodes. Work products include reproducible financial models, ownership mappings, technical assessments, savings reconciliations and actionable recommendations. The manager integrates financial and technical findings into internal advice; customers retain purchasing, production-change and accounting authority. This pod does not represent UST's entire business or provide round-the-clock production support.
